name: Tarija
assessment: A local municipal cadastral viewer and public parcel API were evidenced. The current viewer JavaScript identifies GISCloud map 1460802; the public API exposes the lotes polygon layer and safe codigo_cat field. A bounded anonymous response returned 117 parcel records and three full polygon samples were retained. Runtime remains held pending serial review.
queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Spanish discovery was performed. The official municipal website linked to public municipal services, the official gazette documented Ley Municipal Nº 338 Catastro Municipal Multifinalitario, and the municipal viewer JavaScript was followed to its current GISCloud API. Map metadata returned EPSG:32720. Layer metadata returned four layers; lotes was selected because it is the parcel polygon layer. A bounded source-CRS request returned 117 records; per-feature geometry requests returned GeoJSON polygons for three safe records.

sourceFieldMapping.__id: not retained; GISCloud feature row identifier

retainedSamples.propertiesShape: exactly one canonical native identity: {id: codigo_cat}

attempts.outcome: Official Gobierno Autónomo Municipal de Tarija site retrieved; public services and municipal context observed.
Official Concejo Municipal gazette retrieved; Ley Municipal Nº 338 Catastro Municipal Multifinalitario listed.
Municipal Catastro Multifinalitario viewer HTML retrieved; current JavaScript bundle identified.
Viewer configuration inspected; GISCloud iframe map 1460802 identified.
Map name catastral, owner-independent public metadata, EPSG:32720 and UTM zone 20 south proj4 returned.
Four public polygon layers returned; lotes layer 3787283 covers the parcel polygons.
Safe schema returned one field: codigo_cat string.
Bounded request returned 117 features and safe IDs/bounds; geometry was null in the list response.
Three per-feature requests returned full Polygon geometry and codigo_cat; three samples retained after EPSG:32720 to CRS84 transformation.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal Tarija cadastral map as represented by the public viewer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Bounded EPSG:32720 area around the immutable WUP point; three per-feature geometry responses.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point preserved and not shifted.
A bounded sample is not citywide coverage evidence.
No inference from exact-point hit/miss was made.
No raw unsafe attributes were requested or retained.
The viewer/API may be historical: map metadata modified timestamps are from 2021, while the viewer remained publicly reachable on the research date.
This packet is research evidence, not source integration/admission.

qualification.reason: CRS transformation, public endpoint stability, citywide coverage, native identity admission, and adapter behavior require independent serial qualification.

uncertainty: The public response is sufficient to verify a local cadastral parcel layer and safe ID-plus-geometry sample. It does not prove that all Tarija parcels are present, that codigo_cat is immutable across updates, or that the endpoint is suitable for production runtime. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS disablement was used.
